documents.title: Evaluation Employee Handbook v2
pages: Remote Work Policy. Employees may work remotely on Tuesday and Thursday. Monday, Wednesday, and Friday are office days unless a manager approves an exception.
Expense Policy. Employees must submit expense receipts within 10 calendar days of purchase. Manager approval is required for any single expense above 500 dollars.
Security Incident Reporting. A suspected security incident must be reported within one hour through the security portal. Employees should notify the IT security team promptly.
Security Incident Handling. Employees must not investigate a suspected incident themselves. Preserve relevant evidence and wait for instructions from the security team.
Paid Time Off Policy. Every full-time employee receives 15 days of paid time off per calendar year. Planned leave should be requested at least two weeks in advance.

documents.title: Evaluation Benefits FAQ v2
pages: Commuter Benefit. Full-time employees may receive a 75 dollar monthly commuter stipend after 30 days of employment. The stipend supports eligible public-transit costs.
Home Office Allowance. Employees may claim a one-time 100 dollar home-office equipment allowance after 90 days of employment. This allowance is separate from commuter benefits.
